candidates.comment: The video talks about EMI from close by circuits, mechanical equipment, and general impedance of wires. Bypass and Decoupling capacitors can be added to remove this noise. I did not think about having it placed as close as possible to what we are protecting though but makes sense for phase I. Using the larger capacitor will clean low frequencies while the smaller capacitors clean the high frequencies. It’s also important to use ceramic capacitors due to their low ESR (equivalent series resistance). I came across this by accident while designing the phase I circuit.
